create_har_router: create a HarRouter instance from a HAR file to route network requests from recorded traffic
add_page_route: add a page-level route that intercepts requests and fulfills them from a HAR archive
add_context_route: add a browser context-level route that intercepts all requests using a recorded HAR file
handle_route_request: handle a routed network request by looking up the HAR archive and fulfilling, redirecting, or aborting
dispose_har_router: dispose of a HarRouter instance and close the associated HAR file handle
